card.name: Verbs of shape or movement in description
card.fires_on: Verbs and verb endings describing physical shape, motion or change, such as swinging, angles, folds, elongate, creeping, in general web prose about objects or scenes.

modes.label: Shape and motion verbs
modes.description: A verb describing how a thing bends, angles, folds, expands or stretches.
modes.example: The left side of the petal<< folds>> over.

modes.label: Verb endings partway through
modes.description: The ending of a motion verb split into pieces, such as elong-ate or cre-eping.
modes.example: because they elong<<ate>> out into a snout.

modes.label: Other verbs after a subject
modes.description: A verb or pronoun right after a subject, in casual speech or explanation.
modes.example: The foam<< will>> expand into the shape of your ear.

card.plain: It marks words that describe something bending, swinging, folding or moving in everyday descriptions, not drug text.
evidence: The left side of the petal<< folds>> over.
